name: vmodal-find
description: Find moments in VModal video collections and verify every detail of the query on the actual frames before reporting a match. Use when the user asks to find, search, locate or show something (an object, scene, person, place, "a beautiful shot") in a VModal collection or sub-collection, e.g. "Find a red car. Collection: city" or "a beautiful scene in Kyoto". Requires the vmodal MCP (dev branch, with the `find` tool).
